name: PSYC 6303
title: Didactics of Supervision and Consultation
description: Exposure to theories, models, and empirical data pertinent to providing quality supervision of the psychodiagnostic and psychotherapeutic activities of mental health professionals. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: PSYC 5301, 5304, 6301, and 6302; open to students in Clinical Psychology.
